title: Bữa Cơm Ngon Nhất Không Nằm Ở Món Sơn Hào Hải Vị

scenes.flow_prompt: A luxurious restaurant table full of expensive dishes, but the people sitting around it are all looking at their phones with cold expressions, 9:16
scenes.voiceover: Tôi từng ngồi ở những nhà hàng sang trọng,, trước mặt là sơn hào hải vị,, nhưng nuốt miếng thức ăn vào cổ lại thấy nghẹn đắng.

scenes.flow_prompt: Artistic cinematic zen illustration of eating alone fancy restaurant, warm moody lighting, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio

scenes.flow_prompt: A simple rustic Vietnamese meal on a wooden tray with boiled greens, soup, and white rice, warm evening light, 9:16

scenes.tag: GIA VỊ LÀ SỰ BÌNH YÊN
scenes.flow_prompt: Artistic cinematic zen illustration of family laughing eating simple dinner, warm moody lighting, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio

scenes.flow_prompt: Two pairs of chopsticks resting on white rice bowls next to a warm teapot, cozy and peaceful home vibe, 9:16
